ios.desc:
Meet CarLog - car maintenance tracker. App to manage fuel consumption (MPG), car costs and any vehicle-related data. You can easily setup service and payment reminders for both mileage and specific date. With a focus on gas efficiency, mileage, and trip details, CarLog empowers users to monitor car's performance.

Gas mileage calculation (MPG) allows to save money, predict expenses and get useful insights about real vehicle costs. Take control of your car's maintenance and performance with CarLog, the all-in-one car maintenance tracker that combines efficiency, convenience, and data-driven decision-making for a smoother journey on the road.

CarLog main features: 
 • Track fuel up and mileage (odometer readzings)
 • Add car expenses with categories
 • International 
 • Store comments about any expense
 • Charts for transactions, car maintenance cost
 • Gas efficiency and economy
 • Get insides from trends analysis (changes compared to previous period)
 • International units for odometers (kilometres, miles)
 • Gas consumption tracker - Gallons (MPG), Imperial Gallons (MPG), Litres (l/100 km) and other imperial units.

CarLog PRO 

You can unlock additional features for car vehicle maintenance log with subscription or lifetime purchase. Paid CarLog include next features:
 • advanced charts, insights and trends for expenses and gas efficiency; 
 • ability to create own categories collection;
 • notes for transactions and personalised user interface.
